intro: Unwelcome Spirits is a task undertaken for the Windshapers to investigate the unsettling arrival of wind sprites known as 'hollows' in Shadowgale Forest. These strange entities only manifested after the true spirits of the wind departed, prompting the Windshapers to collect their essences to understand what drove the original spirits away.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The paramount concern of the Windshapers is to better understand why the spirits left us, and what we may be able to do to bring them back. One curious fixture of Shadowgale Forest to the north is the presence of a curious form of wind sprite that some call "hollows". We know little of them and why they are there, but we do know that they first started to appear after the spirits of the wind left us.
I need you to go there and disperse them. Gather the remains and bring them back here.
